接受录取后注册 HKU Portal: Register for HKU Portal after accepting your offer
确认接受录取后，留意港大的注册邮件。按邮件启用港大账号，设置 Microsoft: After accepting your offer, look for HKU's registration email. Activate your account, set up two-factor authentication with Microsoft Authenticator and complete Master Registration. Check your HKU email regularly for messages from your faculty and registry.
学生签证入境后填写第 8 步: Complete student visa Step 8 after arriving
持学生签证入境后，按港大学生签证系统的提示填写第 8 步。核对入境小白条上的「允: After entering Hong Kong on your student visa, follow the instructions for Step 8 in the HKU visa system. Check the permitted stay date on your landing slip and retain your e-Visa and landing slip for registration.
原指南把身份证、确认录取文件及电子签证列为办理逗留签注前应备的资料。办证材料和步: The source guide lists your ID, confirmed offer and e-Visa as documents to prepare for the study endorsement. Check the current requirements with your local exit-entry authority and HKU's student visa office.
上传入境文件与领取学生证: Upload visa documents and collect your student card
完成注册后，在 HKU Portal 的 SIS 按提示上传制卡资料。使用签证在: After registration, submit your card documents through SIS in HKU Portal. Students studying on a visa also submit the visa, landing slip and visa expiry date under Compulsory Upload of Visa Docs. Watch for the confirmation and collection emails and bring the originals requested.

使用学院的 TPG 学生管理系统选课。原指南记录过 8 月 12 日至 17 日: Use the school's TPG student management system to enrol. The source guide records 12–17 August for enrolment and 1–14 September for add/drop in its cohort. Check the dates in your own faculty email and portal.

港深通勤：罗湖、高铁和深圳湾: Shenzhen–HKU travel via Lo Wu, high-speed rail and Shenzhen Bay
罗湖：过关后接港铁东铁线，在金钟换港岛线到香港大学站。回程注意东铁线有罗湖和落马:
Lo Wu: after crossing, take the East Rail Line to Admiralty and change to the Island Line for HKU. On the return trip, distinguish Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau trains. In Shenzhen, use exits A1/A2 at Luohu or exit B at Renmin South.

High-speed rail: from Shenzhen North to West Kowloon, then transfer to a bus at Austin. The source guide records 970/970X/973 to HKU West Gate and 970/970X from Centennial Campus to Austin on the return trip.

Shenzhen Bay: the guide suggests checking the Trans-Island coach operator and comparing stops near Shun Tak Centre in Sheung Wan. The guide estimated 1 hour 15 minutes to 2 hours and about HKD 38.90 via Lo Wu. Check current checkpoint hours, schedules and fares before travelling.

登录 Moodle InfoHub 完成学校安排的反诈课程。原指南提醒，这一步会: Sign in to Moodle InfoHub to complete HKU's anti-scam course. The source guide notes its connection to library and JULAC access. Check your access after completion according to university instructions.
先看港铁学生乘车优惠的适用资格，再比较实体卡和手机八达通的申请方式。原指南记录两: Check eligibility for MTR student fares and compare applications for a physical or mobile Octopus. The source guide records different processing times. Follow MTR or the Octopus app for current processing, proof and transfer requirements.

原指南附了同学的手机操作教程。申请后，请先在八达通 App 核对学生身份和优惠状: The original guide links to a student's mobile tutorial. Check your student status and fare concession in the Octopus app after applying.
完成反诈课程并取得图书馆权限后，从港大图书馆 JULAC Card 页面打开申请: After completing the anti-scam course and obtaining library access, open the form on the HKU Libraries JULAC Card page, sign in and submit it. HKU Libraries lists a processing time of seven working days. Bring your student card to the Main Library enquiries counter on 2/F to collect it. Access and borrowing rights vary by status and institution.
连接 HKU 校园网，用 Portal 账号打开 uPrint，选择 Web P: Connect to the HKU campus network and sign into uPrint with your Portal account. Choose Web Print and submit your file and copy count. At a printer in the library, Chi Wah or another listed location, tap your student card or sign in, select the job and print.
